description: Attach a participant to an interview. Provide either actor_id (existing actor) or persona_spec (ad-hoc persona: name, bio, traits), not both. Vary personas and devices across participants (expertise, motivation, scepticism, mobile vs desktop) for richer findings, and use behaviour to dial scepticism, technical literacy and frustration up or down. Call once per participant, then launch_interview.

actor_id.description: Actor UUID from list_actors, to run an existing actor (with its knowledge) as the participant. Must belong to the interview’s workspace. Provide this or persona_spec.

behaviour.description: Optional behavioural sliders, each 0 to 100. They shape how the participant answers and how long it persists with a task, on top of its persona. Omit a trait to leave it to the persona.

frustration.description: 0 is endlessly patient, 100 has a short fuse: gives up on tasks sooner and carries a failed task into the next.

scepticism.description: 0 takes the product at its word, 100 assumes there is a catch until shown otherwise.

technical_literacy.description: 0 is confused by jargon and icon-only controls, 100 is a technical expert.

device.description: Browser viewport the participant uses: desktop, tablet or mobile. Defaults to "desktop".

interview_id.description: Interview UUID, from list_interviews or create_interview.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for the browser and language, e.g. "en-US" or "fr-FR". Defaults to "en-AU".

persona_spec.description: An ad-hoc persona for this interview only, with name, bio and traits. Provide this or actor_id.

avatar_seed.description: Optional seed for the generated avatar; omit for a random one.

bio.description: A few sentences on who they are, what they are trying to do and what they know.

name.description: Display name for the persona, e.g. "Sceptical finance lead".

name: add_interview_participant

behaviour.description: Behavioural sliders (scepticism, technical_literacy, frustration), or null.

status.description: Participant run status: pending, running, completed, failed or cancelled.

title: Add interview participant
